desc: Compute S=sum(nums) and offset S; return -1 when k is outside [-S, S] (target bit out of range).

Positive-product DP: per parity, dict product -> bitset of alternating sums; seed single elements, transition p -> p*x (pruned if >limit) with +x (even) / -x (odd) shifts; scan products high-to-low for bit k+offset.
Zero-product DP: four bitsets (even/odd × zero-free/has-zero) over all elements including zeros; check has-zero reachability for sum k.
Combine: return largest positive product if present, else 0 if zero-product reachable, else -1.
Validate examples and edge cases (zeros, product-1 from ones with k=0, k out of range, limit=1, element >limit before a zero); manual trace of all three provided examples passes.
